travel.intro: Most guests fly into Edmonton International (YEG). The venues are in south Edmonton, about 30 minutes from the airport.

airports.name: Edmonton International
airports.tips: Direct flights from major Canadian hubs. Connections from India typically through Toronto or Vancouver.

airports.name: Calgary International
airports.tips: Calgary works if that is where you land, but it is about a 3 hour drive and not a quick trip. Fly into YEG when you can.

gettingAround.title: Rideshare and taxis
gettingAround.text: Uber and taxis are available throughout the area.

gettingAround.title: Car rental
gettingAround.text: A rental car is recommended. The venues are a short drive apart in south Edmonton. Parking is free.

gettingAround.title: Transit
gettingAround.text: ETS buses and the LRT may not be a convenient way to the venues, so plan on a car or rideshare.

international.title: Travelling from outside Canada
international.text: Check entry requirements early. Visitors from visa-exempt countries need an eTA (about CAD $7, usually approved within minutes). Others may need a visitor visa, which can take weeks. We are happy to provide an invitation letter; message a coordinator.

aroundTown.name: Elk Island National Park
aroundTown.text: Bison, elk and prairie lakes about 45 minutes east of the city. A morning trip if you have a car.
aroundTown.address: 1-54401 Range Road 203, Fort Saskatchewan, AB T8L 0V3

aroundTown.name: West Edmonton Mall
aroundTown.text: One of the largest malls in the world: shopping, an indoor waterpark and an amusement park. A reliable afternoon if the weather turns.

aroundTown.name: Savoy's South Indian Kitchen
aroundTown.text: Kerala-style South Indian cooking on 34 Avenue, a few minutes from the Mehendi and Vidhi venue. Order a ghee roast or masala dosa, or paneer and veg kurma if you want a curry.

aroundTown.name: Olive Garden
aroundTown.text: Italian-American cooking on Gateway Boulevard, close to the south-side venues. Unlimited breadsticks and salad, with plenty of pasta if you want a familiar meal.
aroundTown.address: 4110 Gateway Blvd NW, Edmonton, AB T6J 6S7

aroundTown.name: The Golden Spoon
aroundTown.text: A dine-in Indian room in southeast Edmonton, out toward Tamarack. Start with samosas or paneer pakora, then dal makhani, palak paneer and garlic naan.

aroundTown.name: Daal Roti
aroundTown.text: Bombay-style Indian cooking on Gateway Boulevard, near the south venues. Come for dal and tandoori roti, with chaat, samosas and tandoor grills on the menu.
aroundTown.address: 3645 Gateway Blvd NW, Edmonton, AB T6J 5V5

paragraphs: Having you there to celebrate with us is the greatest gift of all.
For those who have asked, we've put together a small registry, and a contribution toward our first home together would be warmly appreciated.
Thank you for your love and support.

faq.q: What are Mehendi, Vidhi, and the wedding?
faq.a: Mehendi is an evening of henna. Vidhi is a morning Grah Shanti puja for peace. The wedding is our marriage ceremony, with vows around the sacred fire.

faq.q: What should I wear to each event?
faq.a: Mehendi: colourful and comfortable. Vidhi: traditional and comfortable. Wedding: colourful and comfortable — wear whatever you feel comfortable in. Rich, elegant colours are welcome; it is better to avoid black.

faq.q: What will the weather be like?
faq.a: Afternoons are usually around 23°C (73°F), then it cools quickly in the evening, so bring a light shawl or jacket. A brief shower is common, so a compact umbrella is useful.
The wedding menu is fully vegetarian.

faq.q: Do you have a registry? What about cash gifts?
faq.a:
Your presence at our wedding is the greatest gift of all.
We kindly request no gifts or envelopes—only your blessings and warm wishes.
Parking is free at every venue. Accessible spaces are beside each main entrance.
Shuttles are not confirmed or coordinated yet. We will update this page when we have news. Until then, we recommend a rental car or rideshare.
Please arrive 15 to 20 minutes early so you can find your seat before each event begins.
